description: This file contains unit tests for the SystemHandler class in the Android app, specifically testing system notification handling including authorization, validation, and posting behavior.

classes.name: SystemHandlerTest
classes.description: Contains test functions verifying the behavior of SystemHandler's handleSystemNotify method with various inputs and scenarios.

classes.name: FakePoster
classes.description: A mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster used in tests to verify notification posting behavior without actual network calls.

classes.name: ThrowingPoster
classes.description: A mock implementation of SystemNotificationPoster that simulates failures by throwing exceptions, used to test error handling.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsUnauthorized
methods.description: Tests that an unauthorized poster cannot send notifications and results in NOT_AUTHORIZED error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsEmptyNotification
methods.description: Tests that empty or whitespace-only titles or bodies are rejected with INVALID_REQUEST error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_rejectsInvalidRequestObject
methods.description: Tests that incomplete JSON request without 'body' field is rejected with INVALID_REQUEST error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_postsNotification
methods.description: Verifies that a valid request results in a successful post and counter increment.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_trimsAndPassesOptionalFields
methods.description: Ensures optional fields are trimmed and passed correctly in the notification request.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnauthorizedWhenPostFailsPermission
methods.description: Tests that security exceptions during posting yield a NOT_AUTHORIZED error.

methods.name: handleSystemNotify_returnsUnavailableWhenPostFailsUnexpectedly
methods.description: Tests that unexpected exceptions during posting produce an UNAVAILABLE error with message.
